description: Use this when the user asks who is injured, doubtful or suspended in Fantasy Premier League, for one club or all: 'Arsenal injuries', 'is Saka injured?', 'who's out this week?', 'any injury news?'. FPL's own flags with their news and chance of playing, plus unconfirmed injury reports for players FPL still lists as fit (say these are reported, not confirmed by FPL), and for injured or doubtful players what reporters say about their absence when FPL's news lacks it (also not confirmed). For one player's full picture, player_projection is better.

club.description: Club name or short name; default all clubs.

name: injuries
